trends.title: Cat Night Zoomies Fix
trends.raw_quote: At 2, 3 and 4am they decide to throw a banger of a party every night. So I wake up and kick them out. Leaving me exhausted for work the next day.
trends.problem_summary: Cats become hyperactive and destructive at 2-4am, keeping owners awake and causing exhaustion and property damage.
pain_points: Sleepless nights multiple times per week
Property damage from cats knocking things over during zoomies
No clear protocol to fix the behavior
Guilt over being frustrated with natural cat behavior
trends.guide_viable_reason: Pre-bed play routines, automatic feeders, environmental enrichment, and circadian rhythm management are all well-documented solutions that fit a 10-page guide.

trends.title: Cat Wire & Cable Chewing Danger
trends.raw_quote: How do I stop this terror from chewing cables / wires, I've tried the dish soap method & I've tried spraying with a bottle (which I don't want to use) when he bites cables and neither works. He's so persistent on chewing them.
trends.problem_summary: Cat persistently chews electrical cords and cables, creating fire hazard, damaging expensive electronics, and causing ongoing stress for owner.
pain_points: Hundreds of dollars in damaged electronics
Spray deterrents and home remedies not working
Owner afraid to leave cat alone with cables
trends.guide_viable_reason: Solutions include cord covers, bitter spray alternatives, taste aversion training, alternative chewing outlets, environmental management, and play therapy. All fit a 10-page guide.

trends.title: End Picky Eating Without Short-Order Cooking
trends.raw_quote: Short-Order Cooks: Parents who ask their child what they want for each meal, then make it; give LOTS of meal alternatives; get their child something else when they deny a meal; sometimes feel like failures for giving in when they WANT their child to just eat.
trends.problem_summary: Parent has become short-order cook for toddler who refuses family meals, leading to daily stress, separate meal prep, and worry about child's nutrition.
pain_points: Making separate meals for toddler every single night
Daily stress and frustration at mealtimes
Worry about whether child is getting adequate nutrition
Feeling like a 'failure' for not being able to get child to eat
trends.guide_viable_reason: Solutions include family meal structure, repeated exposure protocols, division of responsibility, no-pressure mealtime environments, and food chaining. All actionable and fitting a 10-page guide.

output: Proceed to Stage 2 for all 3 trends with score > 8/10
